A full solo performance of one or more songs.

A medley in which Daniel Caesar is present and actively performing, even if Daniel Caesar's portion is partial.

A performance in which Daniel Caesar performs entirely via an officially produced and sanctioned satellite feed, video link, or holographic display that is presented as part of the official live event program, provided that the performance is real-time or was produced specifically for and presented exclusively within the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027.

A performance that begins within the official event timeframe but extends beyond it due to scheduling overrun, provided the performance commenced during the official timeframe.
